description: This file defines a Fragment named LogFragment that displays log messages in a scrollable view within an Android application. It handles the creation and setup of UI components like LogView and ScrollView, and provides methods to inflate the view hierarchy and respond to text changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that contains a LogView to display log data. It manages the setup of the view hierarchy, user interactions, and provides access to the LogView instance.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, sets layout parameters, styling, padding, and returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's view hierarchy, adds a TextWatcher to the LogView to scroll appropriately when text changes, and returns the created view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance contained within this fragment.
